decision_conditions:
LOADING BAY (COMPLIANCE): Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, the owner/developer shall enter into a S278 agreement with London Borough of Islington Highways to secure provision of a designated on-street loading bay on Wilson Street in front of the subject site. The loading bay shall be provided prior to first occupation of the development. Works to be undertaken by Islington Council Highways and costs paid for by the applicant. 

REASON: This is to mitigate the impact of the development in the interests of providing appropriate space for loading/unloading, deliveries and collections.
description: Stopping up of part of existing footway on Wilson Street under Section 247 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to enable the development of 7-21 Wilson Street under planning permission ref. P2024/3548/FUL (as amended by non-material amendment ref. P2025/1892/NMA).
